General information only — not medical advice. Consult a professional for personal guidance. Estimate assumes walking; running burns roughly twice as much per step.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter your total step count for the day.
  2. Enter your body weight in kilograms.
  3. Press Calculate to see total calories burned.
  4. Check the per-1,000-step value to compare different days.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How accurate is the calorie estimate?

It is a rough estimate based on average walking energy cost (about 0.045 kcal per step for a 70 kg person), adjusted for your weight. Actual burn varies with pace, terrain, and fitness.

Why does body weight change the result?

Moving a heavier body costs more energy, so the formula scales calories by your weight relative to a 70 kg reference.

Does this work for running?

No — running burns roughly twice as many calories per step. This tool assumes casual to brisk walking.
